Lemma
[identities for Li–Yau–Perelman distance] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 3.2.5\group Cao–Zhu Comparison Theorems for Perelman’s Reduced Volume For the Li-Yau-Perelman distance $l(q,\bar{\tau })$ defined above, we have \begin{align} \frac{\partial l}{\partial \bar{\tau }} & =-\frac{l}{\bar{\tau }}+R+\frac{1}{2\bar{\tau }^{3/2}}K,\\ |\nabla l|^2& =-R+\frac{l}{\bar{\tau }}-\frac{1}{\bar{\tau }^{3/2}}K,\\ \Delta l & \leq -R+\frac{n}{2\bar{\tau }}-\frac{1}{2\bar{\tau }^{3/2}}K, \end{align} in the sense of distributions. Moreover, the equality in $(3.2.13)$ holds if and only if we are on a gradient shrinking soliton.
